neighbours.label: The word 'offer' in a property purchase or sale negotiation.
fire: The buyers submitted a cash offer for the cottage.
Our agent advised us to raise the offer on the house.
The seller accepted our offer for the apartment yesterday.
Please make an offer before the property goes to auction.
Their offer on the warehouse included a quick closing.
We rejected the initial offer because the price was too low.
The bank reviewed the written offer for the vacant lot.
A competing offer arrived after our tour of the townhouse.
